explanations.headline: H10's run pulls A6 away creating space for a teammate

claims.text: H10 moved 14.5 metres in the 5 seconds before the pass at 6 seconds.
A6 followed H10’s run closely, moving 9.6 metres in the same time and matching the direction almost exactly.
Because A6 moved away, the defender nearest the receiving spot was 5.0 metres away at the start and 11.1 metres away when the pass was played.
A teammate had a shot just 2.2 seconds after the pass was made.

explanations.headline: Off-ball run pulls defender away to create receiving space

claims.text: H10 moved 14.5 meters off-ball in the 5 seconds before the pass at 6.0 seconds.
The defender A6 followed H10's run closely, moving 9.6 meters with a direction match of 0.99.
A6 was 5.0 meters from the receiving zone at run start and increased to 11.1 meters when the pass was played, creating space for the teammate.
The nearest defender to the receiving zone also moved from 5.0 to 11.1 meters between run start and pass play timing.

explanations.headline: Off-ball run by H10 creates space for teammate at 6 seconds

claims.text: Player H10 moved 14.5 metres in the 5 seconds before the pass at 6.0 seconds.
Defender A6 followed H10's run over 9.6 metres with a cosine match of 0.99.
A6's distance to the receiving zone increased from 5.0 to 11.1 metres when the pass was played.
The nearest defender to the receiving zone was 5.0 metres away at run start and 11.1 metres at pass time.

explanations.headline: H8 and H6's quick one-two breaks two defenders

claims.text: The chance began when H8 played the origin pass at 2.4 seconds for North London Red.
H6 returned the line-breaking pass at 3.1 seconds, bypassing two South Coast Blue defenders A10 and A11.
The attack moved forward over 24 metres with a total of three passes leading to the shot.
The chance started 5.8 seconds before the shot and 3.6 seconds before the final pass.

explanations.headline: One-two pass breaks two opponents advancing 24 meters

claims.text: Player H8 played the origin pass at 2.4 seconds in a one-two pattern.
Player H6 returned the line-breaking pass at 3.1 seconds bypassing opponents A10 and A11.
The sequence from the origin pass to the shot included three passes covering 24 meters forward.

explanations.headline: One-two pass by H8 and H6 initiated chance with 24 m progression

claims.text: The origin pass was played by H8 at 2.4 seconds.
H6 played the line-breaking return pass at 3.1 seconds, bypassing 2 opponents A10 and A11.
The sequence included 3 passes from the origin to the shot.
The chance began 5.8 seconds before the shot and progressed 24.0 metres from the origin pass to the shot.
